formulaBlock.normalization: No split synonym entries; no markers. Normalized positions (ID-2) equal packet positions 1-14.

cleansingStrength.rationale: Low by C6: no strong anionic anywhere; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the nonionic glucoside Decyl Glucoside@2, followed by the mild anionics Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate@3 (sulfosuccinate) and Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate@4 (sulfoacetate). PEG-55 Propylene Glycol Oleate@5 is a PEG thickener (not cleansing, not buffer). Formula-only.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: cleansing-led architecture; the only conditioning route is the cationic starch Hydroxypropyl Oxidized Starch PG-Trimonium Chloride@11, listed after Parfum@7 and the preservatives (not prominent). No silicone, lipid, refatter, pearlizer or deliberate humectant (Propylene Glycol@6 is a solvent; Sodium Lactate@14 is a pH buffer, C2/F4). Neighbor moderate: the cationic starch could add noticeable slip.

wLineRecord.plausibility: No candidate before the cap; the E3 marker Parfum@7 is the earliest candidate: (i) Decyl Glucoside@2 before it; (ii) nothing between it and the cap. W-line = cap.

weightPotential.counterevidence: Mild chassis gives less reset than a sulfate system; a cationic starch can deposit lightly.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: One deposition family only: a cationic starch listed after Parfum and the preservatives; no silicone, lipid, refatter, protein or film former.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate: a single light, late cationic starch with no reinforcing route; there is nothing for even a mild-surfactant reset to offset, so noticeable residue is unlikely.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: None material; complete formula with a single late light route.
weightPotential.rationale: Low (6.6 low anchor). Reset capacity read as moderate for this low-deposition architecture (mild surfactants but almost nothing to remove). W-line = cap Parfum@7; no payload_lipid to gate.

careDirection.limitation: No deliberate humectant, lipid or protein route; formula distinguishes neither moisture nor repair.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: The only distinctive formula trait is a very mild, sulfate-free chassis (mildness is not a focus, 7.2); a sensitive-scalp role would need SC1 positioning.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Claim direction null (hidden). Lengths care nonspecific. Mild base (MB) makes a sensitive-scalp role formula-compatible if claimed. Provisional general.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered; no claims visible. Provisional.

usageRole.rationale: Provisional default regular: claims hidden. Cleansing low, so frequent fires with U2 frequency wording graded moderate/high.

scalpComfortTarget.csaRoute: No listed prominent E4 comfort or humectant/refatting route (positions 1-6 hold none). CSA met only via MB (v1.6.2): cleansingStrength low and no prominent strong anionic -> mild_base:Decyl Glucoside@2, Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate@3, Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate@4. MB passes CSA and the S-SENSITIVE gate only, never S-DRY.
scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Provisional not_targeted: SC1 positioning hidden. Formula half (CSA) met via MB only, so targeted is possible for a sensitive-scalp claim; a dry-scalp claim would fail S-DRY (no prominent humectant/refatting route). Fragrance declared (Parfum@7) is a supportive-signal absence, not a veto; no cooling agent.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Not supported: no Piroctone Olamine, Climbazole, Selenium Sulfide or Selenium Disulfide (Section 11).

nonionicCleansing: Decyl Glucoside@2 (earliest prominent cleansing surfactant, C6)

conditioningRoutes: Hydroxypropyl Oxidized Starch PG-Trimonium Chloride@11 (cationic polymer, not prominent)
